subject: Checkpointed original-client movement from completed S5 wounded-soldier objective toward inferred Conrad corpse placement
setup: Isolated original compatibility client 1.16.5.0 with deployed-derived normal-hostile Game/world copy. Copied character has mission 1995 objective 2 completed and objective 3 active after run 66. Its copied DB login coordinates were explicitly edited to the measured run-66 dialogue position (-102.39844,86.68221,73.4375). Runs 67-72 use ordinary client movement from that diagnostic checkpoint. No live service or database was changed.

observations.source_location: run 67 at-soldier-checkpoint.png; copied character_mission_objective after run 66
observations.finding: Original client restored tracker Remove the bomb from Conrad’s corpse; position at login was about (-102.395,86.89,73.438). Objective 3 was active.

observations.source_location: run 67 toward-corpse.png and run 68 toward-corpse.png; read-only .where
observations.uncertainty: Client display precision about 0.01 m. Route began from edited diagnostic checkpoint.
observations.finding: Left strafe from the soldier checkpoint reached approximately (-98.64,85.77,70.25) after 1.0 s and (-98.75,85.77,70.07) after 1.5 s. Further leftward input barely moved; nearby scenery occluded the view toward the inferred corpse placement (-98,85.39,67.2). A right click did not send RequestUseObject or advance objective 3.

observations.source_location: run 71 toward-corpse.png and run 72 east-of-corpse.png, toward-corpse.png; read-only .where
observations.uncertainty: Client display precision about 0.01 m; input timing and collision may vary.
observations.finding: Alternative diagonal inputs reached (-98.16,86.02,72.45) and (-98.47,85.65,71.29); follow-up movement turned west to (-101.34,85.66,69.94). These probes did not reach the corpse object or resolve the correct around-prop path.

The emulator navmesh returns a complete path via (-96.0,86.11,70.8), (-95.6,85.91,69.2), (-96.0,85.91,67.2), then (-98.0,85.81,67.2). This is a candidate route around the scenery; client collision has not verified those corners.

assessment: The checkpointed original client confirms objective 3 presentation after the soldier interaction and can move to the corpse vicinity. The tested straight and diagonal input sequences stop or divert near original scenery and have not generated a corpse use request. Prior isolated teleport-based evidence verified the implemented corpse use, but ordinary approach remains unverified. The corpse coordinate is inferred, not a recovered original server location.
next_verification: Steer the original client around the east side of the obstacle toward the navmesh corner near (-96,70.8), then south to (-96,67.2) and west toward the reconstructed corpse; verify RequestUseObject, objective 3 completion and timer. Recheck the inferred placement if ordinary client collision cannot reach it.
